title: CutMapContract — audio-led cut-map prompt validator
purpose: Validates the authoring structure of an audio-led cut-map prompt (as documented in art_01M681XTD8NSXT3N2KQF8NQFZB r1) before generation. Checks beat ordering, clip-duration bounds, required fields per beat (music_event, camera_move, cut_type), camera direction (mismatch-3 risk), world head count (mismatch-1 risk), fence negatives, precise final pose (mismatch-6 risk) and loopable-end declaration. Distinct from BeatOrderContract (8670325a) which targets narrative portrait structure in the twelve-block workflow.
